verdict.rationale: Granola has a documented native HubSpot integration that auto-syncs meeting notes to the correct contact, company, and deal records via folders (granola-docs-10, granola-docs-18, granola-docs-39). However, there is no evidence of native, first-party Salesforce or Attio sync — those would have to rely on the generic Zapier integration (granola-docs-9), which is not CRM-specific and not verified to map notes to the right records automatically. Missing for 10: direct native Salesforce integration, direct native Attio integration, and confirmation that Zapier-based sync correctly attaches to the right deal/contact for non-HubSpot CRMs.
